title: DADDY DEVIL SPAMMER
features:
😈 DADDY DEVIL SPAMMER 😈⚡

A highly customizable message broadcasting utility featuring a stylish red neon UI, multi-recipient targeting system, built-in message editor, and RX Chat integration. Optimized for Delta and mobile/PC executors.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅ Custom Loading Screen — Devil red neon theme with progress bar.
✅ Draggable UI — Move the window anywhere and minimize to a floating 😈 button.
✅ Message Broadcaster — Customizable Recipient, Symbol formatting (default ~), Character Count, and Interval Speed.
✅ MULTI-RECIPIENT (10 Slots) — Type up to 10 names. The script automatically detects filled slots and cycles through them.
✅ MESSAGE EDITOR — Add, edit, delete, and save your custom messages. Saves to your executor's files (daddy_devil_messages.txt) so they persist between sessions.
✅ RX CHAT INTEGRATION — One-click button to fetch and execute the RX Chat script from GitHub.
✅ TextChatService & Legacy Chat — Works in all Roblox games.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ HOW TO USE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Execute the script in your executor (Delta, etc.).
2. Wait for the loading screen to finish.
3. Set your Recipient, Symbol, Count, and Speed.
4. Click 📝 EDIT to customize your messages.
5. (Optional) Click 🎯 MULTI (10) to add multiple recipients. It will auto-cycle through them.
6. Press ▶ START to begin broadcasting.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
